past.title: CCCHR Monthly Meeting | Dec. 23rd
past.body:
Join us for our Monthly Meetings | 4th Tuesday of Every Month

All car club member/representatives are invited to our meetings, which are scheduled the fourth Tuesday of every month. We’ll be discussing what and how the Car Club Council can help and represent the car clubs of the Southside of Hampton Roads and Northern North Carolina. Our goal is to provide a sounding board for all car clubs on the Southside and to be a single voice in support of automotive legislative activities in Virginia and North Carolina. As well as a single location to advertise car club member events on our website calendar. We will also provide a central point for advertising of automotive related facilities and products.

Looking forward to seeing you all at the meeting!

DUES ARE $30.00 FOR ALL CAR CLUBS AND ARE DUE TO THE TREASURER BY MARCH OF EACH YEAR.

Please park behind the building and enter through the Parts department door. For all you guys driving lowered vehicles, beware that the parking lot is full of speed bumps. 1495 South Military Highway, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Saturday, November 22nd | 11A-4P

Located at Chesapeake City Park | 900 City Park Dr, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Mark your calendars and join Team Ultraspeed and some of our amazing partners for our 2nd annual charity car show to benefit local non-profit animal rescues in Hampton Roads!

Event registration will go live in June, so hang in there! Car show pre-registration will be $25, day-of registration will be $30. 100% of registrations will be donated to the rescues!

past.title: MCT Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Toy Collection Event & Car Show | Nov. 8th
past.body:
MCT Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Toy Collection Event & Car Show

Saturday, November 8th | 9a-3p

Located at 3312 Princess Anne Rd, Virginia Beach, VA 23456

The Mustang Club of Tidewater is proud to announce we will be holding our second Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Official Toy Collection Day and Mustang Club of Tidewater All Makes and Models Car Show!! This show is to support the Toys for Tots Hampton Roads program as they ramp up for Christmas, 2025. The car show is open to the public, so bring your favorite car, truck, or bike/trike and help support your community!! We ask that you be generous in your donations of new, unwrapped toys for boys and girls in the Hampton Roads area.

Click the event image to see the show flyer!

Date/Times: November 8th, 2025.
- Toys for Tots Toy Collection from 9:00am until 2:30 pm.
- Car Show from 10:00a.m until 3:00p.m.
- Registration for the Car Show and Drive Through Toy Drop-Off Lane both open at 9:00 a.m.

We invite you to be a participant or spectator, but if you cannot, there will be a Drive-Through Drop Off Lane for the community to make donations at the Toy Collection Event site!! Please pass the word to family, friends, and coworkers to help us collect toys to support the kids in Hampton Roads this holiday season!!!

Location: Landstown Commons Shopping Center, 3312 Princess Anne Road, Virginia Beach, VA, 23456, in the southwest parking lot adjacent to Princess Anne Road. Enter behind Dollar Tree.

Admission: The registration fee for vehicles entering the car show is $20, plus at least 1 new, unwrapped toy, for donation to the Toys for Tots program. The first 100 registered vehicles will receive a Dash Plaque for the show. There is NO Pre-Registration for this show. All registration payments and toy collections will happen at the show site. There is no charge for spectators to visit the show area, but we do ask that you make a toy donation to Toys for Tots as well. There will be a designated drive through drop-off lane for community members to donate toys at the show location.

Music and announcements will be provided by DJ Vinlo!

Show Details: This is a Participant's Choice show. All registered entrants will be provided with voting slips to record their top 25 vehicle choices. Spectators will receive a judging slip to pick their favorite vehicle. Awards will be made as follows:
- Best in Show
- Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Choice
- Most Toys Donated by Group/Club participating in the Car Show
- Most Toys Donated by an Individual participating in the Car Show
- Top 25 Participant Choices based on Participant voting
- Top Spectator Choice based on Spectator voting

Schedule for November 8th:
- 0800: Set up show lot, toy donation collection points, and vendor displays. No show vehicles will be admitted prior to 0830 (except for MCT and TFT members working the show).
- 0900: Registration desk opens for the show. Toy collection begins for car show participants, show spectators, and the public wishing to make toy donations.
- 1000: Car show officially starts. Participant and Spectator Judging begins.
- 1030: Driver meeting with info on show, vendors and other pertinent information.
- 1200: National Anthem is played. All military vets and members recognized.
- 1300: Car Show Registration Ends. Toy collection continues until 1430.
- 1330: Car Show Judging Ends. Please have your judging slips turned in by this time.
- 1430: Toys for Tots Toy Collection Ends. Award Presentations Begin, 50/50 Drawing Held.
- 1500: Car Show Ends. Please depart in a safe and orderly manner. No Loud music, Burnouts, or Exhibitions of Speed. This is a very busy shopping center that grants us permission to use their parking area for shows. We don't want to risk losing this site.

The USMC Reserve Toys for Tots Staff, and the MCT members thank everyone that will be attending and/or supporting this event. We hope for a great turnout from our community! Thank you for participating!

More info

[1ST sun] Cheeseburgers & Classic Car Cruise in SMITHFIELD

Sunday, November 2nd | 2-5p

Hosted by Farmer’s Table of Smithfield, 13416 Benns Church Blvd, Smithfield, VA 23430

Cheeseburgers & Classic Cars is a family event open to all automotive enthusiast. We welcome all Classic Cars, Trucks, Motorcycles and Tractors, including show quality restorations to rusty survivors and everything in-between on the 3rd Sunday of each month! Bring the kids, young and old! no fees or registrations. Please do not park in the front row - thank you.

Sumospeed Fall Classic sponsored by Lowered Legends

Sunday, November 2nd | 1p


Located at Virginia Beach Convention Center | 1000 19th St, Virginia Beach, VA 23451

Fully screened car show registration (will be observing a "catfish" policy. Cars that arrive at roll in that appear different than registered photos can be turned away without a refund). 150,000 sq ft indoor car show plus 90,000 sq ft carpeted lobby/prefunction space and large outdoor section taking place on 19th st. in front the building. Make/Model/Specialty awards

Registration pricing: Vendors: $250/10x10 indoor space | $150/10x10 outdoor space

Vehicles: $55 Indoor | $35 Outdoor

past.title: Cars and Coffee Norfolk | Nov 1st
past.body:
(1st & 4th Sat) Cars and Coffee Norfolk

Saturday, November 1st | 9-11a

Located at Black Rifle Coffee Company, 216 E Little Creek Rd., Norfolk. 

Monthly car meet - occurs on 4th and 5th Saturdays of every month. Free coffee and doughnuts! All cars, motorcycles, bicycles, etc. welcome! Park in the back lot (please only take one space). Coffee will be supplied! We'd love to get a food truck to attend, so if you operate one, or know of someone who would be interested, send us a message!

Please no: Revving, loud music, burnouts.
